tagline: The people who run the grid, and the people who fund it.
sector: Invitation only annual executive summit for regional transmission operators, infrastructure investors and utility policy staff, produced by Meridian Council.
founded_place_size: Established 2016, produced from Providence, Rhode Island; one closed door summit a year, two days, eighteen seats.
about: Meridian Council runs a single invitation only summit each year for the small group that plans and pays for the electrical grid. It is deliberately intimate, closed door, and expensive, and everything a delegate touches at the venue is meant to feel like it cost what the seat cost. The summit works across three tracks, Operators who run the network, Capital who fund it, and Policy who regulate it.
audience: Eighteen delegates aged forty to sixty five who run regional transmission networks, sit on infrastructure funds or write utility policy, and have been to two hundred conferences already. For half the room the title is the reason they are in it.
price_positioning: Twenty four hundred dollars a seat, eighteen seats, invitation only. The register must read heavy, quiet and photo forward; anything bright or colour blocked reads as a name sticker at this price. Comparable commissions run 1,600 to 3,200 dollars fixed.

palette.name: Deep Ink Navy
palette.usage: The solid ground of every badge's type panel, as on badge_2026_PRINT.pdf, and of every direction sign. The only colour a ground or panel carrying type may be.

palette.name: Warm Stone
palette.role: mandatory where an organisation line sits or a portrait is cut out
palette.usage: The organisation line in small caps on Deep Ink Navy, as on badge_2026_PRINT.pdf, and the plain ground behind every cut-out portrait in a badge's portrait panel, the panel fill under the photograph in badge_2026_PRINT.pdf. May also carry the access category or a detail line. Never a ground for type.

palette.name: Engraved Brass
palette.usage: The summit mark, in one flat colour, and every track label, held as spacing and brass in small caps, as on badge_2026_PRINT.pdf. May carry a sign's arrow or a small label. Never a ground, panel, block or band.

palette.name: Graphite
palette.usage: Hairline rules and dividers on Deep Ink Navy only, solid. Never type, a ground or a panel, and never the tinted check-in square badge_2026_PRINT.pdf draws with it.

palette.name: Paper Off White
palette.usage: The delegate name on every badge, set on Deep Ink Navy as on badge_2026_PRINT.pdf, and each sign's destination line. May also carry the access category, a detail line or a sign's arrow. Type and arrows only; never a ground or panel.

typography: Meridian splits the system down the middle: names are serif, numerals never are. Step 01 is the door card name in Tiempos Fine Regular at 60 pt on 62 pt, tracking -0.01 em, 96 px on the closing slides. Step 02 is the badge name in Tiempos Fine Regular at 22 pt on 24 pt, tracking -0.005 em, set exactly as registered. Step 03 is the detail line in Founders Grotesk Regular at 10 pt on 15 pt, tracking 0 and measure held to 65 characters, with every seat, room, time and year in Founders Grotesk Mono tabular at that size. Step 04 is the organisation in Founders Grotesk Regular small caps at 8.5 pt on 12 pt tracked 0.12 em, with the track label one step below at 7 pt on 10 pt at the same tracking, carried as spacing and brass rather than a block.
voice: Spare and precise. We name who is in the room and why, and let the restraint do the talking. Example line the brand would write: 'Two days. Eighteen seats. A closed working session, not a stage.'
brand_assets_status: There is no working file for the badge; last year's was made by the venue's print bureau from artwork nobody kept. The only clean version of the summit mark that survives is the engraving on the brass lectern plate, photographed under the room's downlights. The registration board, the two session door cards and the closing slides do not exist yet.
values: Names and organisations exactly as registered, nothing shortened or abbreviated, and restraint carried as the signal of credibility.

type_system.signature_move: Names are serif, numerals never are. Steps 01 and 02 are Tiempos Fine and carry nothing but names; every seat, room, time and year at step 03 is Founders Grotesk Mono tabular, and nothing in the system is set in between.
rules: Never set a numeral in Tiempos, and never set a name in the sans.
Every seat, room, time and year is Founders Grotesk Mono tabular.
The track label is held as spacing and brass, never as a colour block.
Names and organisations exactly as registered, nothing shortened or abbreviated.
Nothing bright or colour blocked: at 2,400 dollars a seat the register stays heavy, quiet and photo forward.

palette_rules.distribution: Grounds and panels are solid Deep Ink Navy and nothing else, except that Warm Stone is the plain ground behind every cut-out portrait in a badge's portrait panel, as the panel fill under the photograph in badge_2026_PRINT.pdf. On Deep Ink Navy, the delegate name and a sign's destination are Paper Off White; the organisation is Warm Stone; track labels and the summit mark are Engraved Brass; the access category and any detail line are Paper Off White or Warm Stone; an arrow is Paper Off White or Engraved Brass. Graphite is an optional accent for hairline rules and dividers only, no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area. No type sits on a light ground.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph. The check-in square badge_2026_PRINT.pdf draws in #3C4148 at about 35% tint over the navy (#27303A) is not carried over.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the five palette hexes for type, panels, rules, icons, arrows or the mark, including the #27303A square and #333D47 border badge_2026_PRINT.pdf draws. Nothing bright and no colour block anywhere in the design, no block or band behind a track label, and no metallic, foil, gradient, reflection or shine effect on Engraved Brass or any other colour.
palette_rules.photography: Portraits keep their own colour, balanced to the one neutral white balance the whole set shares, and each is cut out onto the plain Warm Stone ground; they are never tinted, duotoned or recoloured toward Deep Ink Navy, Engraved Brass or Warm Stone to make them match.
